name: Rite Zone Chemcon India Ltd.
summary: Rite Zone Chemcon India Ltd. manufactures and sells a range of construction and concrete chemical products. The company offers solutions for civil construction, infrastructure, and building and structure projects, covering both pre-construction and post-construction needs. Its product portfolio includes concrete admixtures, waterproofing systems, industrial flooring, engineering grouts, pumping aid chemicals, tile chemicals, concrete repair materials, curing compounds, mould release agents, and various types of concrete. The company primarily targets the Indian market within the chemicals industry, specializing in construction chemicals and concrete products.
